$comment: Layonara's NUI house style (nwn-module docs/NUI-STYLE.md, checked against origin/ee on 2026-11-17), written as generic rules: the numbers (the 36 px row, the 8 and 16 px gaps, the 1000 x 720 limit, the palette) are the guide's. Each rule was decided from an audit of Layonara's windows (DESIGN.md, 'Problems and house style'). Guide-only, not checked: a heading is 28 tall, a drawn text line 18-20 for a name line and 16 for a secondary line (the JSON cannot tell a heading or a line's role).
title: Layonara (example)
description: Layonara's NUI house style, included as an example of a style file to copy and adapt: fixed-size windows sized to their content, one spacing grid, no help paragraphs, short one-line tooltips, every disabled control explains itself.

fixed-size.summary: Windows are not resizable (sizes are static, nothing reflows). Layonara exempts the customisation window.

max-content.summary: Content of at most 1000 x 720, so the window fits 1920 x 1080 at UI scale 1.0 with the quickbar and chat.

gaps.summary: Empty room between things is 8 or 16 (as a footprint); the 4 between controls comes from their margins. Fillers (over 32) are not gaps.

tooltip-length.summary: A tooltip or disabled tooltip is one short line, at most 60 characters (the client never wraps it and draws "\n" as "?"); longer help goes in the window as wrapped text. Bound ones are checked by their sample values. Layonara exempts the gods window (its deity titles are game data).

list-rows.summary: List rows that hold text are at least 32 tall (a 24 row cuts the 17 px font).

close-width.summary: The Close button is 120 wide (footprint: width 116 with the default margin), in every window.

drawn-progress.hint: draw the bar instead: a track rect (55, 50, 44) and a gold fill whose rect is bound, with the figures above it

palette.$comment: The guide's named colours (gold, name, body, muted, ..., black, white), then the achievements' level colours (Achv_LevelColor in achv_i_show.nss).
palette.summary: Colours come from the named palette (gold headings, name, body, muted, good, short, blocked, separator, frame, track) or the achievement levels'. Drawn game art (image items, a board) is not checked.
